title: X.509 chain validation and cross-signing support
description: Implement X.509 certificate chain validation for LICHEN. Must handle: single CA (cert chains to one root), cross-signed CAs (cert chains through a cross-signature to a different root), hybrid signing (ML-DSA CA cert signing Ed25519 device cert). Use existing crypto libraries (Python: cryptography, Rust: x509-cert/webpki, C: mbedTLS). Key behaviors: accept any chain that terminates at a root in the trust store, reject expired certs, reject certs with wrong key usage. Test with: self-signed CA, two cross-signed CAs, chain depth 2 and 3.
